raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Low-Impact Strength for Knee Health and Ski Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength and knee-friendly progression for return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Knee-friendly Progressive Loading" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Knee-friendly squat pattern and upper body":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and knee-friendly hinge":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper body strength and core stability":
        warmup:
          rowing 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          plank 3x20 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Knee-friendly loading progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_adduction stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Active upper body strength":
        warmup:
          row_machine 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          military_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shrugs 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Emphasis with Moderate Knee Load" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength under controlled knee load":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat (low depth) 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat (low depth) 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute bridge 2x60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Hinge emphasis and pulling":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/pull with core rotation":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3: Peaking Strength and Ski Preparation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Heavy compound focus with control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_bridge 2x60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Posterior chain and single-leg prep":
        warmup:
          hiking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_variant 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          lunge 3x6..8 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_coster_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper body density and core":
        warmup:
          rowing 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Grip, core, and stability":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          ab_rollout 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Taper preparation and movement quality":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sealrow 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Conditioning with low impact options":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x8..12 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4: Return-to-Ski Readiness" (0 weeks but taper and ski-specific readiness retained):
    // Phase 4 reserved for final taper and ski-specific drills after Week 12 assessment
    // Implement ski-specific warmups and movement screens as needed outside core programme

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY:
  push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES: 
  running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Note: This programme is designed to be knee-friendly with controlled ranges and no jumping or deep knee flexion under load. Adjust ranges and depth to surgeon/trainer guidance as needed. Prioritize pain-free technique and gradual progression.
